oral_examination.oral_examination: Poor oral hygiene, tartar, soft plaque, pigment, obvious redness and swelling of the gums, bleeding at the gum margin, no periodontal pockets, and no obvious loosening of the teeth.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Full mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling, polishing and medication. OHI oral hygiene education, education on brushing teeth, flossing, and using interstitial brushes.
